items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to blood clot in calf after doctor consultations; out for foreseeable future. Tanner McKee will start.
items.why: Superficial blood clot requiring IR; consultations Saturday.
items.implication: McKee starts; no rushing upside from QB; skill players downgraded somewhat but pass-catchers healthy.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Dontayvion Wicks in McKee offense; Dameon Pierce lead back snaps with Barkley/Shipley out.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after returning to practice this week (high-ankle sprain).
items.implication: Instant WR2 upside in return; monitor snap ramp-up.
items.opportunity: High target share potential vs Jets; Berry starting as WR2.

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT (hamstring) for Eagles vs Panthers; did not practice all week. Will Shipley also OUT (foot).
items.implication: Dameon Pierce expected heavy workload as lead back behind compromised OL with McKee at QB.
items.opportunity: Pierce carries/snaps/goal-line; residual for any elevated backs.

items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice no setbacks (hamstring); listed Q but starter reps.
items.why: Full practice week; took starter reps.
items.implication: Bears offense upgraded; watch for any snap limits but projected full go.
items.opportunity: Boost to Rome Odunze, DJ Moore (if active), Cole Kmet, D'Andre Swift usage.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.implication: Depth WR addition with Lamar out; monitor targets behind Flowers/Bateman.
items.opportunity: Possible slot/route share increase if volume there.

items.text: Please pick up Tanner McKee in any league needing QB if available; will be better than you think; not worried about Eagles skill players with him.
items.why: Hurts IR; McKee can play; skill talent intact.

items.text: Assuming A.J. Brown active for Patriots he'll be active for me; starting him as WR2 wherever I got him.
items.implication: Strong WR2 start in return spot.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT (ankle) again for Ravens vs Browns; Tyler Huntley expected to start.
items.implication: Huntley QB; Flowers/Andrews/Likely still viable but lower ceiling.
items.opportunity: Slight bump to Zay Flowers/Mark Andrews in pass game; no Lamar rush TDs.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin) for Texans; Tank Dell also OUT.
items.implication: Joe Mixon or handcuff elevated for carries.
items.opportunity: Backup RB snaps/carries/redzone in London game.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for Jets vs Patriots; Adonai Mitchell also OUT.
items.implication: Breece handcuff or committee (Braelon Allen etc) for volume.
Xavier Worthy, Hollywood Brown or others elevated targets with Mahomes.

items.text: DeVonta Smith IN/removed from injury report (prior hamstring/toe); full go with Hurts out.
items.implication: Primary WR1 for McKee; solid WR2 floor.

items.text: ETR Cheap WR Volume for Week 6 live: WRs under $5k DK/$6k FD projected 5+ targets.
Jeremiyah Love OUT (ankle) for Cardinals vs Rams.
items.implication: Trey Benson or committee for ARI RB work.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense being a buffet for pass catchers.
items.why: Soft matchup vs WAS pass D.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) with bankable usage.
Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5); elite usage lately vs leaky run D.
Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB situation.
